High school diploma or school leaving certificate qualifying you for admission to German universities

notes: tuition: the EUR 7,900 per semester is the standard-track fee; the intensive track costs 8,850 EUR per semester. The DAAD page states 'English language skills B2 required' but no quote explicitly names the B2 certificate as an English-language requirement; the DAAD page attributes the certificate to the English language skills. Any stated entry always includes a high school diploma and, depending on the country, additional requirements. The application deadline given by the DAAD page for non-EU applicants (31 March) has no year, so it is not used. No evidence found for applicationChannel (uni-assist or direct application). Some dates on the KLU page are for the 2026/2027 intake and are future dates; verify with the university.
